title: Cell attachments in the directed-union collage
statement: Use small simplicial sets and nerves from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the ordered join from [lem-coef-infinity-join-cocone-associativity]. Let $K$ be a small simplicial set, $I$ a small nonempty partially ordered set, and $(K_i)_{i\in I}$ an increasing family of simplicial subsets of $K$. Let $M\subseteq K\star N(I)$ contain the pure $K$ and nerve simplices and exactly those mixed simplices $\sigma\star(i_0\leq\cdots\leq i_n)$ for which $\sigma\in K_{i_0}$. For a simplicial subset $Y\subseteq N(I)$ let $M_Y\subseteq M$ contain $K$ and those pure upper or mixed simplices whose upper block lies in $Y$. Suppose $Y'=Y\cup\tau$, where $\tau:\Delta^n\hookrightarrow N(I)$ is a nondegenerate strict chain $(i_0<\cdots<i_n)$, $n\geq1$, not in $Y$ and with $\partial\tau\subseteq Y$. The natural map $K_{i_0}\star\Delta^n\to M_{Y'}$ is degreewise injective, its intersection with $M_Y$ is exactly $K_{i_0}\star\partial\Delta^n$, and the induced comparison $$M_Y\amalg_{K_{i_0}\star\partial\Delta^n}(K_{i_0}\star\Delta^n)\longrightarrow M_{Y\prime}$$ is an isomorphism of simplicial sets. At the vertex stage, $M_{N(I)^{(0)}}=K\cup\bigcup_i(K_i\star\{i\})$, and two distinct local cones intersect only in $K_i\cap K_j\subseteq K$. These assertions include empty $K$ and empty $K_i$; no directedness or covering assumption is required.
